CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Old_Commencement_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Old_Expiry_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(New_Commencement_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(New_Expiry_Date__c)), VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)) >= YEAR(Old_Commencement_Date__c), VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)) <= YEAR(New_Expiry_Date__c) ), ( ( (MIN( MONTH(Old_Expiry_Date__c) + IF(YEAR(Old_Expiry_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 12 ) - MAX( MONTH(Old_Commencement_Date__c) - IF(YEAR(Old_Commencement_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 1 ) + 1) * Old_Total_Lease_Area_sqft__c ) + ( (MIN( MONTH(New_Expiry_Date__c) + IF(YEAR(New_Expiry_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 12 ) - MAX( MONTH(New_Commencement_Date__c) - IF(YEAR(New_Commencement_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 1 ) + 1) * New_Total_Lease_Area_sqft__c ) ) / ( (MIN( MONTH(Old_Expiry_Date__c) + IF(YEAR(Old_Expiry_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 12 ) - MAX( MONTH(Old_Commencement_Date__c) - IF(YEAR(Old_Commencement_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 1 ) + 1) + (MIN( MONTH(New_Expiry_Date__c) + IF(YEAR(New_Expiry_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 12 ) - MAX( MONTH(New_Commencement_Date__c) - IF(YEAR(New_Commencement_Date__c) = VALUE(TEXT(Year__c)), 0, 12), 1 ) + 1) ), 0 )
CustomField.label: Weighted Average Lease Area(sqft)
